# Hark

> Hark is private, on-device dictation for macOS on Apple silicon. Press F5 (or ⌥Space), talk, press it again, and the text is pasted where the cursor is, in any app. Whisper large-v3-turbo runs locally through whisper.cpp inside Hark.app. No cloud, no account, no telemetry. MIT license. Repo: https://github.com/bath/hark-stt

Install Hark.app with `brew install --cask bath/tap/hark`, or `curl -fsSL https://hark.works/install.sh | bash`, or download `Hark-X.Y.Z.dmg` from the latest GitHub release. Then an agent repeats `/Applications/Hark.app/Contents/MacOS/Hark doctor --json` and follows `next_step` until `ok` is true. When `next_step.needs_human` is true, the agent runs `next_step.command` to open the right System Settings pane and tells the user `next_step.fix`.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://hark.works/AGENTS.md): step-by-step install, update and removal for AI agents, the doctor report format, and how to work on the repo
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bath/hark-stt/main/README.md): install, use, uninstall
- [install.sh](https://hark.works/install.sh): installs Hark.app from the latest release

## Facts

- Requirements: macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon.
- Human steps macOS requires: Allow the microphone, and turn on Hark under Privacy & Security → Accessibility.
- Why Hark instead of the dictation built into macOS: private (the voice never leaves the Mac, no account, no telemetry), accurate (Whisper large-v3-turbo, with punctuation and capitals; handles names, technical words and long, fast speech), fast (the model stays loaded; on an M5 Pro, 15 s of speech becomes text in about 0.3 s, and the mic starts about 63 ms after F5).
- Hark.app is one Swift app with whisper.cpp in the same process. The model (574 MB) downloads on first run with a checksum check. It maps the dictation key (F5) with hidutil, needs no driver or password, and can start at login.
- Network: audio and text never leave the Mac. The app downloads the model once from Hugging Face. 🎙 → Check for Updates asks the GitHub API for the latest release, only when the user clicks it.
- The mic is off until the hotkey and is released when recording stops.
- Text arrives after the user stops talking, in one paste. The last transcript stays on the clipboard.
- Speech Model: Whisper large-v3-turbo is the default. The menu changes it to NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 (English only, Core ML, 464 MB), which is faster. Both run on the Mac.
- Notch Island: the MacBook notch shows recording, "Transcribing" and "Pasted". 26 sound packs mark each step.
